body:
Source: GitHub issue #608 (bug, P1-high, false-green). Re-verified on main @ 920973bb: packages/context-handoff/lib/recovery-exception.mjs:42 SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS.bypass omits '--dir'; lib/paths.mjs:23 resolveHandoffDirs resolves the ledger as resolve(cwd, dirFlag) with no upward search. 'handoff bypass --session X --write' run from a repo subdirectory writes <subdir>/.adlc/handoffs/X.bypass-grant.json and prints 'handoff bypass: recorded bound grant … (consumed by the next authorized mutation)' with exit 0, while the enforcing hook reads the grant at its own cwd root, so the operator stays locked out with no allowed way to retarget.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. Package packages/context-handoff (bin/handoff.mjs bypass handler near lines 788-910; lib/recovery-exception.mjs grammar + SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS + formatRecoveryCommand; lib/paths.mjs; lib/cli-helpers.mjs commonOrExit; lib/bypass-grant.mjs). Tests: npm test -w packages/context-handoff. Consumers (plugins carry trusted local twins of the recovery grammar): plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/handoff-gate.mjs, plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/adlc-handoff-gate.mjs and their tests (handoff-deny, bypass-grant-hook, build-gate-recovery-exception). Do NOT edit plugins in this lane; if the recovery grammar change needs a twin update, STOP and report. Grep first and name which twin tests parse SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS.

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. Add '--dir': 'value' to SUBCOMMAND_FLAGS.bypass only if the plugin twins do not require byte-identical flag tables (check; if they do, STOP and report instead of widening). The bin already documents --dir for bypass; the grammar must accept the same value grammar (VALUE_RE) and the existing '--dir must end in .adlc' refusal.
2. With --write, bypass must verify the resolved <root>/.adlc/handoffs directory already exists BEFORE writing the grant; if not, exit 1 (operational) with a message naming the resolved path and saying run from the repo root or pass --dir <repo>/.adlc; nothing written, no audit record, and the 'recorded … grant' line is never printed. Dry-run (no --write) prints the resolved ledger path.
3. Existing behaviour from the repo root, exit codes for other failures, and grant contents unchanged.
4. Documentation: update packages/context-handoff/README.md and make the SAME edit by hand in apps/docs/content/docs/toolkit/context-handoff.mdx (hand-maintained mirror — never regenerate).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 Run from a subdirectory with --write and no handoffs dir at the resolved path: exit 1, message names the resolved path, no grant file, no 'recorded' text. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/bypass-ledger-dir.test.mjs`
- AC2 --dir <root>/.adlc from a subdirectory writes the grant in the right tree. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/bypass-ledger-dir.test.mjs`
- AC3 Recovery-exception grammar accepts the --dir form and still rejects malformed values. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/bypass-ledger-dir.test.mjs`
- AC4 Repo-root invocation unchanged. verify: `node --test packages/context-handoff/test/bypass-ledger-dir.test.mjs`
- AC5 Existing suite and plugin twin tests green. verify: `npm test -w packages/context-handoff` plus the plugin consumer tests named in the lane.
- AC6 Docs updated in both places. verify: grep for the new statement in README and mdx.
- AC7 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0 (also --max 80 locally).

OUT OF SCOPE: #609 (self-clearing D1/D2 via bypass), upward ledger search, plugin edits.
title: context-handoff: bypass accepts --dir and refuses to report a recorded grant when the resolved ledger has no handoffs directory
